note: Hale County, TX does not zone unincorporated land (Texas counties generally lack zoning authority outside cities). Largest city Plainview publishes its zoning districts only as a code section, an ordinance PDF and a zoning map page with a legend; no queryable ArcGIS REST zoning layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or city pages. Its Interactive Map is a public viewer whose service could not be identified (page returned 404 on fetch). Hale Center, Abernathy and Petersburg zoning was not found as a published service either. Searches of ArcGIS Online for Hale County/Plainview zoning returned only roads, address points and bike-plan layers.
